title: Taking the Elevator to Space
topic: A lift at the world record speed of 21 m/s (Hitachi, Guangzhou CTF) climbing from the ground to the ISS at about 419 km: Burj Khalifa top in 39 s, Everest in 7 min, the Armstrong limit in 15 min, space in 1 h 19 min, the ISS in 5 h 33 min; going down at 10 m/s takes 11 h 38 min
